info.title: Capisum API
info.description: Payment orchestration platform API — dashboard (bearer JWT), public (API key), and Capisum admin (internal) surfaces.

post.summary: Exchange Auth.js identity assertion for dashboard JWT
Resolve dashboard access from identity assertion
Get invite details for authenticated user

get.summary: Get webhook endpoint for current environment

put.summary: Set webhook endpoint URL for current environment

patch.summary: Update webhook endpoint for current environment

delete.summary: Remove webhook endpoint for current environment

parameters.name: reference
parameters.description: Search full history by Capisum or provider reference

dashboardBearer.description: One-hour dashboard access token from POST /api/v1/auth/token-exchange

capisumAdminApiKey.description: Capisum platform admin API key (CAPISUM_ADMIN_API_KEY). Internal ops only.

message.example: The selected provider is not supported.

assertion.description: Short-lived HS256 JWT signed by the Next.js Auth.js server

user_id.description: Omit to broadcast to all active org members

PayInRequest.description: Deprecated generic pay-in body. Use POST /v1/transactions/pay-in/merchant-wallet or POST /v1/transactions/pay-in/customer-wallet.

currency.description: Pay-in currency. For crypto, `asset` may be used instead.

asset.description: Crypto asset ticker (e.g. btc, usdt). Alias for currency on Quidax deposits.

network.description: Required for crypto pay-in. Quidax blockchain network (e.g. trc20, erc20, bep20, bitcoin).

customer.description: Required for customer-wallet pay-in. Email identifies the Quidax sub-account; name maps to first/last name.

PayoutRequest.description: Initialize a payout through Capisum. Amount is in minor units (NGN kobo, or 8-decimal units for crypto). Use GET /v1/payouts/capabilities for provider-specific currencies, countries, rails, and required_fields. Required destination fields depend on the resolved provider + country + currency + rail (for example USD ACH needs routing_number/account_type; NGN bank needs bank_id).

amount.description: Amount in minor units. Quidax crypto uses 8 decimal places (500000000 = 5 USDT).

currency.description: Payout currency. Supported set is the union of provider rails from GET /v1/payouts/capabilities.

rail.description: Payout rail. Inferred when only one rail matches the resolved provider+country+currency; otherwise required (PAYOUT_RAIL_REQUIRED).

recipient.description: Beneficiary profile. Required only when the selected rail lists recipient.* fields.

physical_address.description: Beneficiary street address (not a crypto wallet address).

account_number.description: Bank account / CLABE / CCI number, or mobile wallet number.

address.description: Required for crypto_wallet. Destination crypto wallet address (not beneficiary street address).

account_name.description: Account holder name. Also satisfies rails that require recipient.name.

bank_id.description: Capisum canonical bank id from GET /v1/reference/banks (e.g. ng.opay). Required for many NGN bank rails.

bank_code.description: Provider/corridor bank code when Capisum bank_id is not used (e.g. some Yativo corridors).

mobile_money_code.description: Normalized mobile money network (e.g. MTN, SAFARICOM).

network.description: Required for crypto_wallet. Blockchain network (e.g. trc20, erc20, bep20).

destination_tag.description: Optional memo/tag for networks that require it.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Required when a currency has multiple corridors.

phone.description: Wallet phone number. Defaults to account_number for mobile_money.

reference.description: Optional client reference. Capisum generates one when omitted.

provider.description: Optional explicit provider slug (e.g. fincra, yativo, quidax).
